title: Improve PSL completion documentation, snippets, and field suggestions
body:
## Linked issue

n/a — editor quality-of-life improvements; Linear reference omitted as requested.

## At a glance

```text
map("${1:name}")
```

Attribute snippets now show argument names instead of empty placeholders. Autocomplete details explain the selected construct instead of displaying generic labels.

## Summary

Make PSL autocomplete more informative and keep field-reference suggestions limited to scalar fields.

## Decision

Use documentation from authoring descriptors for completion details, add short descriptions for built-in declaration keywords, and make snippet placeholders self-explanatory.

## Notes for the reviewer

Documentation metadata is optional: third-party descriptors without it retain their existing fallback details. Field filtering preserves registered constructor-backed scalars, including aliases, while excluding relation and composite fields. No runtime or schema semantics change.

## How it fits together

1. Scalar, generic-block, and block-parameter descriptors can carry documentation; built-in registrations supply descriptions.
2. Completion items use those descriptions, along with existing attribute, argument, function, and identifier documentation.
3. Required argument snippets name their placeholders, block snippets hint at their contents, and field-reference suggestions resolve scalar types in the declaring or referenced model.

## Behavior changes & evidence

- Descriptive completion details and block hints: [completion provider](packages/1-framework/3-tooling/language-server/src/completion-provider.ts), covered by [provider tests](packages/1-framework/3-tooling/language-server/test/completion-provider.test.ts).
- Named argument placeholders and documented argument values: [snippets](packages/1-framework/3-tooling/language-server/src/completion-snippets.ts) and [value completions](packages/1-framework/3-tooling/language-server/src/completion-values.ts), covered by their corresponding package tests.
- Scalar-only field references: [symbol resolution](packages/1-framework/3-tooling/language-server/src/completion-symbols.ts), covered by [symbol tests](packages/1-framework/3-tooling/language-server/test/completion-symbols.test.ts).

## Testing performed

- Language-server test suite: 611 tests passed.
- Language-server and framework-components package typechecks passed.
- PostgreSQL target, SQL family, and Mongo family package typechecks passed.
- Block-documentation tests: 9 passed across PostgreSQL, SQL family, and Mongo family.
- Focused scalar-registration tests: 46 passed across six packages.
- Changed-file Biome checks and `git diff --check` passed.

## Skill update

No skill update required: these changes improve editor presentation and suggestions without changing authoring syntax or workflows. The language-server README documents the metadata and completion behavior.

## Checklist

- [x] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO.
- [x] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the change is scoped to one logical concern.
- [x] Tests are updated.
- [ ] The PR title uses a Linear ticket prefix — intentionally omitted as requested.
- [x] The Skill update section is filled in.

## Alternatives considered

- Hardcoding scalar and block descriptions in the language server: keeping documentation on contributions lets extensions participate without target-specific server logic.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Language Server completions now show documentation for types, blocks, parameters, functions, and values.
  * Completion suggestions use descriptive placeholders based on argument names.
  * Declaration snippets provide clearer guidance for required fields and block contents.
  * Field-reference suggestions are limited to applicable scalar fields, excluding relations and composite fields.
  * Added documentation for supported SQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MongoDB types and blocks.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved completion details and filtering for configured and custom scalar types.
